boss_intro: Shhh. The lighthouse sleeps… and I am the dark between its blinks.
Found me? No, little one. I found you. I always find you.
taunt_mid: Over here. No… here. Hee hee.
You chase the shadow and miss the smile.
Softly, softly. The night is patient.
hit_react: Ah! Bright little thing, aren't you.
A touch! How rude. How impressive.
low_hp: The dark is thinning… how curious…
You've lit too many corners, clever rex…
defeat_freed: The cog slips off like a shadow at noon… and I am my own again. Thank you, bright one.
Caught — fairly, kindly, cleverly. The night owes you a favour.
